metadata.case_name: HO KWAI KONG v. CHEUNG KOK

plaintiff.occupation_before: Sole proprietor of a pork meat shop (Chinese roast meat worker / "sifu" in pork raw meat shop)

injuries.description: Cortical break at distal left radius (fracture of distal left radius)
source: it was discovered that he sustained a 5 cm oblique chop wound at his distal left forearm, and the X-ray revealed that there was a cortical break at distal left radius, the arm bone.
injuries.icd_description: Fracture of lower end of radius

injuries.description: Multiple extensor tendons cut on the left forearm (tendon lacerations)
source: there were multiple extensor tendons cut on the left forearm
injuries.icd_description: Injury of multiple muscles or tendons at forearm level

injuries.description: Superficial branch of radial nerve was cut (radial sensory nerve injury)
injuries.body_part: superficial branch of radial nerve, left forearm
source: superficial branch of radial nerve was also cut
In the course of the operation the tendon and the nerve were repaired
injuries.icd_description: Injury of radial nerve at wrist or hand level

manifestations.description: pain when being pressed on the area of the wound
tightness on the part of his injured left arm
splintage which handicapped the Plaintiff's movement on the left arm (splint fitted for four weeks)
pain and inconvenience in the recovering process

treatments_received: exploration of the left forearm wound (emergency operation)
fitted with a splint on his left wrist with thumb in extension

losses.description: 18 per cent impairment of the upper extremity (reduced function of left upper limb / fingers)
Unable to return to previous manual work as Chinese roast meat worker / sifu in pork raw meat shop; could not hold the raw body of the pig which required a lot of strength in his left arm

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: Handicapped in not being able to play previous music such as erhu, Chinese Violin, banjo and pipes; deprived him of his basic and main enjoyment as a hobby

Chan Kai Wing v. Leung Fat Kee Engineering Factory Company Limited
